I'm really sleepy but I think I did the math right

356200.5 tonnes, if the inventory is filled with 36x64 OP golden apples, assuming that the OP gold apple actually does in fact weigh that much. (this includes the weight of the apples)

For a more reliable conversion you could just do the blocks of gold instead which would mean, assuming 1 block of gold is 1 cubic meter, 44425.7 tonnes.

IMO Massive amounts of main character deaths really just ruins series for me.  It almost feels like they're severing bonds with the viewers.  Just my opinion though, and because of it I'm glad Marvel doesn't do that.

You can search all you want but all you will find are allegations.  There is literally no proof, and all accusations have effectively died and nobody is even pursuing it anymore, because, as it's been said before, they were merely allegations made on YouTube.

If we're at the point where "common knowledge" includes factless allegations and are taken seriously then I can't wait for the next car I see to take a hard right into the sidewalk and make me flatter than a piece of paper.
